# A new customer asking for the guid `{guid}`.
#
# The test fills in a guid the book already holds on a vendor or a tax table.
# GnuCash keeps one guid to one thing, so the customer cannot have it.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the customer.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_new_customer_is_refused_a_guid_another_object_has.py.
customer "C-TAKEN"
	name: "A Customer Asking For A Taken Guid"
	currency: CAD
	guid: "{guid}"
